property_summary: After a successful initialize with given ProductInfo, the product's public name and symbol equal the values provided in that ProductInfo.
After a successful initialize, the product is not closed (closed() returns false), regardless of the initialization parameters.
initialize always reverts when the provided fundingFee exceeds 1 (1e18 fixed-point), regardless of other parameters.
If initialize succeeds with a given maintenance value, the product's maintenance() afterwards equals that value; otherwise initialize reverts.
After a successful initialize with a given makerLimit, the product's makerLimit() equals that value; otherwise initialize reverts.
A product whose accumulator has never been settled (latestVersion == 0, so no oracle version has been recorded) must always revert on settle(), since settlement requires oracle data.
On a freshly deployed product, every account has zero maker/taker position, zero maintenance, zero collateral-backed accumulator version, and is not liquidating.
The product's utilization buffer is always zero for any caller state/inputs.
On an uninitialized product, updateClosed must always revert because the caller can never be the product's coordinator owner.
On a fresh (uninitialized) product, any position-modifying call such as closeTakeFor must revert for every account and amount, since settlement requires an uninitialized oracle.
On a freshly initialized-but-empty product, rate() of any position must return a zero Fixed18, since the stored utilization curve is all zeros.
For any position, rate() computes from the all-zero stored utilization curve and therefore returns a zero Fixed18.
For any position with zero taker amount, c.rate() returns a zero Fixed18 (PackedFixed18 0) regardless of the maker amount.
On a fresh product, positionAtVersion always returns a zero Position (maker and taker are both zero) for any queried version.
For any address with no activity on the product, c.pre(account) returns an empty pre-position (version 0 and zero open/close maker and taker amounts).
On an uninitialized product (latestVersion 0, no oracle set), openTakeFor must revert for any account and any amount — positions can never be opened before the oracle bootstraps the product.
On a freshly deployed product (before initialization), any closeTakeFor call must revert, for every account and amount.
A call to updateClosed by an address that is not the product's coordinator owner must always revert, so the closed flag cannot be flipped by an unauthorized caller.
Before initialization, a product exposes a fully zero state: for any account, latestVersion(), latestVersion(account), maintenance(), and utilizationBuffer() are all zero, regardless of inputs.
utilizationBuffer() always returns UFixed18Lib.ZERO (0) for any input.
After a successful initialize(productInfo), the product's public parameters persist: maintenance(), name() and symbol() return exactly the values passed in ProductInfo.
After a successful initialize, maintenance() returns exactly the UFixed18 value passed in ProductInfo.
After a successful initialize, maintenance() persists exactly the UFixed18 value passed in ProductInfo (and zero otherwise).
initialize must revert when the ProductInfo funding fee exceeds 1 (UFixed18Lib.ONE).
initialize always reverts when the supplied ProductInfo funding fee exceeds 1e18 (UFixed18 ONE).
On an uninitialized product (latestVersion() == 0, oracle unset), any openTake attempt always reverts.

property_summary: On a freshly deployed (uninitialized) product with no oracle version set, any attempt to open a make position for any account and amount must revert.
closeMakeFor must revert when the caller is neither the account nor the product owner, and only ever succeed when the caller is the account itself.
initialize can only succeed once: a second initialize call always reverts, and the product's name set by the first successful initialize is never overwritten.
A second call to initialize always reverts, regardless of the ProductInfo given.

property_summary: A successful initialize stores exactly the name, symbol and oracle given in the ProductInfo, and the product starts un-closed with latestVersion 0.
If the oracle address in the ProductInfo is not a contract, initialize must revert; if it is a contract, initialize succeeds and stores the given name.
An uninitialized product cannot be used: openTakeFor always reverts (oracle and account checks fail), regardless of account or amount.
After a successful initialize with a contract oracle, the product's public name() and symbol() equal the provided values and closed() is false.
